channel.title: My Azeroth Life (Podcast)
channel.description: Tales told by the fire from a reborn Azeroth. An old lorewalker opens his ledger and reads the true chronicles of real World of Warcraft characters: the roads they walked, the friends they found, the gold they earned and the trouble they wandered into. Pour some tea and stay a while.
channel.itunes:author: Tim Apple

item.title: Feathers, Pumpkins and One Thistle Boar
item.description: From World of Warcraft Forever. A greatest-hits introduction to Tim Apple’s Forever roster, told by its chroniclers: two Cudsong brothers on Red Cloud Mesa, a dwarf who finds the snow personally offensive, a Skyborne mage who falls with style, a night elf druid and his one thistle boar, and a Forsaken paladin whose Light still burns him every time he uses it.
item.content:encoded:
Game version: World of Warcraft Forever

A greatest-hits introduction to Tim Apple’s Forever roster. The Mulgore Chronicler opens the show and tells how Ruminant and Bullseye Cudsong took their first steps on Red Cloud Mesa. Then four new chroniclers pick up the strongest moments from this week’s posts: Rip in the snow of Coldridge Valley, Parzelle Starfall coming of age above the clouds, Tristan Shadowmane under the boughs of Aldrassil, and Forever Ghoulsbie, a Forsaken paladin whose Light still burns him.

Andric, a Human Priest and Tim’s newly chosen Forever main, is named only in passing; his story has not been written yet.

Chapters:

  1. Intro
  2. Roll Call
  3. The Cudsong Brothers: Two Calves on Red Cloud Mesa
  4. Rip: Wolf Meat and a Simple Rune
  5. Parzelle: Falling With Style
  6. Tristan: One Thistle Boar
  7. Ghoulsbie: The Light That Burns
  8. Outro

item.title: Wings, Ghouls and a Very Long Monday
item.description: From World of Warcraft Retail. In this bonus episode, Tim introduces his two new Retail characters, the classes WoW Forever doesn’t have. Lemmindris, a night elf demon hunter, gets a fast, action-packed origin from Ashenvale to the burning sky of Mardum. Ghoulsbie, a human soldier of Lordaeron who died, rose as one of the Forsaken, then died again and became a death knight, gets a darker and more cynical one.
item.content:encoded:
Game version: World of Warcraft Retail

A bonus episode. Tim opens it himself, with a few words from his post “Steel Over Sparkles”: for Forever he is going analog with a Warrior, Rogue, Hunter and Paladin, which leaves Retail for the two classes Forever doesn’t have. Then two new narrators tell where those two came from.

The Mardum Chronicler follows Lemmindris, a night elf demon hunter who could never sit still, from an apprentice druid’s grove in Ashenvale to Illidan’s side, through years in a cell and back out again, wings out and glaives up. The Acherus Chronicler tells the colder story of Ghoulsbie, a human soldier of Lordaeron who died, got up again as one of the Forsaken, died a second time at the Bulwark and rose as a death knight, only to learn he had been promoted to bait.

Chapters:

  1. Intro
  2. Lemmindris: The Elf Who Could Not Sit Still
  3. Ghoulsbie: Promoted to Bait
  4. Outro

  • Steel Over Sparkles: Shuffling My Azeroth Lineup

item.title: Traitors, Eagles and the Keeper of the Smoke Pit
item.description: From World of Warcraft Retail. Laotou tears down the Twilight’s Blade’s pamphlets and cuts down the traitors of Tranquillien, while Burrly jumps from Akil’zon’s Reach on Zul’jarra’s word and goes into the mist of Numazon Crypt to bring out the Witherbark. And Dawnbrisket, the Sunwalker camp cook who kept the smoke pit for the dawn drummers, reaches Fairbreeze, falls four times and rises four times.
item.content:encoded:
Game version: World of Warcraft Retail

Three ledgers are open this week. The Lorewalker follows Laotou (say it “Lau-Toe”) into the fighting at Tranquillien, the Boralus Chronicler takes Burrly off the ledge at Akil’zon’s Reach and into the crypt at Numazon, and the Mulgore Chronicler brings a new name to the show: Dawnbrisket, a Sunwalker who started out as a camp cook.

item.title: The Cud-Singer's Grandsons
item.description: From World of Warcraft Forever. In this special episode, a Mulgore chronicler tells how Grandmother Ohsa sang the kodo through a Kolkar raid and gave the family its name, and how her grandsons Haymaker, Bullseye and Ruminant earned theirs with a mallet, a pebble and a great deal of chewing things over. Then the three Cudsong brothers walk up the road to Camp Narache to begin their journey.
item.content:encoded:
Game version: World of Warcraft Forever

A special episode, and the first Forever show of My Azeroth Life. Below Bloodhoof Village, where a Cudsong sings to the kodo every night, the Mulgore Chronicler tells how three calves became Haymaker, Bullseye and Ruminant, and how they came to walk up the road to Camp Narache with a hammer, a bow and a great many questions.

item.title: Scarabs, Gladiators and the Gates of Zul'Aman
item.description: From World of Warcraft Retail. A beetle ambushes Laotou outside Silvermoon, and the monk gets up, trims the Lightbloom and goes Seeking Truth at Runestone Falithas. Burrly brings down the Gladius Slaurna on the Sunwell’s battlements, then follows Lady Liadrin through the Gates of Zul’Aman to beat the Amani war drums.
item.content:encoded:
Game version: World of Warcraft Retail

item.description: From World of Warcraft Retail. In a Boralus tavern with a storm rolling in, the Chronicler tells the tale of Burrly, a Kul Tiran warrior who walks straight into every fight from Boralus to the Darkway.
